nphi.title: EU CBRN CoE P99 – Strengthening biosafety and biosecurity capabilities in East and Central Africa
nphi.with: Expertise France; SCJS Europe; University of Liège; ISEM Institute
nphi.summary: RIVM leads the national biorisk assessment and biorisk-management work packages and co-leads dual-use research oversight in a One Health biosecurity project.

nphi.title: TESA II – Trials of Excellence in Southern Africa II
nphi.with: Uganda National Health Research Organisation; Health Research Centre of Angola; Biomedical Research and Training Institute; Blantyre Health Research & Training Trust; Botswana-Harvard AIDS Institute; ECRIN; ISGlobal; AIGHD; UCL; Stellenbosch University; University of Namibia; University Teaching Hospital Zambia
nphi.summary: EDCTP2 regional network of excellence strengthening clinical trial capacity in Southern Africa through training and shared infrastructure; Uganda's national health research organisation took part as partner.

nphi.title: EMT ReCaP – Emergency Medical Team response capacities and partnerships
nphi.with: WHO EMT Secretariat (WHO HQ); WHO Regional Office for Europe; WHO Regional Office for Africa; Lviv Regional Center for Emergency Medical Care and Disaster Medicine (Ukraine); Ministry of Health and Social Services (Namibia); Ministry of Health (Malawi); Institute of Emergency Care of Sarajevo Canton (Bosnia and Herzegovina); Arbeiter-Samariter-Bund; CADUS e.V.; humedica; Johanniter-Unfall-Hilfe (Germany)
nphi.summary: Strengthens Emergency Medical Team crisis response in the WHO AFRO and EURO regions through twinning with German EMTs, cross-regional exchange and communities of practice.

nphi.title: Building Stronger Public Health Institutions and Systems (BIS), Phase 2
nphi.summary: Norad-funded programme to strengthen public health institutes in four core partner countries, with selected BIS-1 activities continuing in Uganda and Ghana. Themes are climate and health, digital health, infectious diseases, NCDs and…

nphi.title: Support to the Public Health Institute of Malawi (Team Europe NPHI initiative)
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Malawi (PHIM); Ministry of Health Malawi
nphi.summary: Four-year EUR 4.6 million EU/BMZ co-financed project launched June 2025 to strengthen PHIM and its collaboration with African and European national public health institutes.

nphi.title: Building outbreak diagnostic capacity at PHIM
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Malawi (PHIM); University of Liverpool; Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine; The Pandemic Institute
nphi.summary: PHIM lab scientists were trained in molecular diagnostics at MLW, a national mpox diagnostics workshop was held, and a shared primer bank with SOPs for over 40 pathogens was set up at MLW and PHIM.

nphi.title: IANPHI Africa Regional Network
nphi.actor: IANPHI Africa Regional Network (co-chair: Institut National de Santé Publique, Guinea)
nphi.with: INSP Guinea; INSP Cabo Verde (co-chair); NICD South Africa; INS Mozambique; NCDC Nigeria; ZNPHI Zambia
nphi.summary: Network of 47 African NPHIs (founded 2013) that works with Africa CDC on NPHI and legal frameworks, scorecards and workforce development, and tracks member NPHIs' progress toward legal status.

nphi.title: BIS collaboration in Malawi
nphi.summary: Institutional support to PHIM as it may become an autonomous body. Includes a new MMed in public health, surveillance gap analysis (IDSR) and biosecurity courses tied to Malawi's JEE.

nphi.title: CDC Malawi – support to PHIM
nphi.with: Ministry of Health; Public Health Institute of Malawi (PHIM); Malawi FETP; National Public Health Emergency Operations Center
nphi.summary: CDC's Malawi office (2001) supports the MOH and the Public Health Institute of Malawi on reference laboratories, the FETP (est. with PHIM 2016), emergency response (cholera, polio, mpox), HIV/TB and immunization.

nphi.title: NIPH global health security partner countries
nphi.with: WHO; IANPHI; Africa CDC; ECDC; US CDC
nphi.summary: NIPH lists Malawi, Moldova and Palestine (besides Ghana) as partner countries for IHR capacity, national public health institute strengthening and emergency preparedness.

nphi.title: Combined Africa CDC Maturity Scorecard and NPHI Staged Development Tool assessment of PHIM
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Malawi (PHIM); GIZ Malawi; Africa CDC; IANPHI
nphi.summary: In November 2025, PHIM completed an assessment combining the Africa CDC maturity scorecard with the IANPHI/CDC Staged Development Tool, covering research, labs and surveillance. It was run by NIPH and GIZ with EU and Norwegian funding,…

nphi.title: Fleming Fund Country Grant for Malawi – Phase 2
nphi.actor: UNC Project-Malawi / UNC Institute for Global Health and Infectious Diseases
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Malawi (PHIM, hosts national AMR data repository); Ministry of Health; AMR National Coordinating Committee
nphi.summary: UNC Project-Malawi runs the phase 2 Fleming Fund grant, building stewardship and lab AMR surveillance whose WHONET data flow nightly to a central server at the Public Health Institute of Malawi.

nphi.title: Gates-funded Integrated Disease Surveillance project
nphi.with: INS Mozambique; NIH Pakistan; others not named
nphi.summary: In 2022, IANPHI ran a Gates-funded study of integrated disease surveillance. It made country deep dives in Mozambique, Pakistan, Malawi, Uganda, England, Sweden and Canada, and held a webinar with NIH Pakistan and INS Mozambique.

nphi.title: Southern Africa summit on establishing and strengthening NPHIs
nphi.actor: Africa CDC Southern Africa Regional Collaborating Centre with ZNPHI
nphi.with: Africa CDC; US CDC; IANPHI; NPHIs of Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique (INS), Namibia, South Africa (NICD) and Zimbabwe
nphi.summary: Three-day September 2019 meeting in Livingstone where Southern African NPHIs held peer exchanges on core functions, lessons and strategies, and agreed that exchange visits and peer mentorship are critical to NPHI development.

nphi.title: African NPHI peer learning around Mozambique's INS
nphi.summary: Delegations from Malawi and Zambia (2016) and Sierra Leone and Uganda (2017) visited Mozambique's national institute to learn from its set-up.

nphi.title: DQA and DQA PLUS – Quality assurance training for African drug quality control labs
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: WHO Regulation and Safety (Switzerland); InphA (Germany); national regulatory authorities and drug quality control labs of partner countries
nphi.summary: Trained national drug QC lab staff in ISO 17025 quality management to detect substandard anti-infectives.

nphi.title: CPA and CPA PLUS – Rational use of anti-infective drugs
nphi.actor: Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM)
nphi.with: African Institute of Biomedical Science and Technology (Zimbabwe); universities in Zimbabwe, Zambia, Malawi; Institute for Clinical Pharmacology, RWTH Aachen University Hospital (Germany)
nphi.summary: Research and training on prudent antibiotic use, pharmacogenetics and TDM to curb AMR.

nphi.title: Zambia and Malawi peer visit to Mozambique
nphi.summary: In 2015, delegations from Zambia and Malawi visited Mozambique to learn how an NPHI is set up and how it works with the Ministry of Health.

nphi.title: Global Health Preparedness Project in Malawi
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Malawi; Norwegian Church Aid; IANPHI; I-TECH; WHO
nphi.summary: Seconded expertise and funding to strengthen IDSR and IHR core capacities. Activities included the 2019 JEE, national health security action planning, FETP, an Ebola simulation and cholera, anthrax and COVID-19 responses.

nphi.title: NIPH–IANPHI workshop for the new Public Health Institute of Malawi
nphi.with: Public Health Institute of Malawi (PHIM); Malawi Ministry of Health
nphi.summary: In February 2014, NIPH and IANPHI held a workshop to plan the structure of the newly created PHIM: a reference library, an epidemiology unit and a research unit. NIPH and IANPHI were to keep giving technical help.

indicators.label: E. coli bloodstream infections resistant to 3rd-generation cephalosporins
